blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: AI agents are commonly specialized for new tasks and domains using skills, i.e. natural language instructions placed in their context. However, the discrete nature of textual skills prevents continuous optimization. Gradient-based approaches such as finetuning, on the other hand, are typically model-specific, preventing skill transfer across different agents. Since many agents today are built on vision-language models (VLMs), we can address these limitations by introducing Skill.png: a method for obtaining skill-like image inputs whose pixels are optimized with gradient descent through the vision encoder of a frozen VLM. Image skills are compatible with any VLM, and a single image can be optimized jointly for an ensemble of models. We show that Skill.png significantly outperforms state-of-the-art textual skills optimized using frontier LLMs in 9 of 16 settings (across 4 VLMs and 4 benchmarks) while requiring only 64 to 256 image tokens instead of roughly 900 to 2000 text tokens at inference time. Hybrid skills, i.e. text and image skills jointly optimized, further improve agent performance. Moreover, an image optimized with an ensemble of VLMs can successfully transfer across the models in the ensemble. Skill.png thus presents the first agent skill that can be optimized with gradient descent while retaining transfer benefits of text skills. Our code is available at: https://github.com/omseeth/skill.png
blocks.zh: 人工智能代理人通常专门从事新的任务和领域,使用技能,即在其上下文中的自然语言说明。 然而,文字技能的离散性质阻碍了持续的优化. 另一方面,精细调整等渐进式方法通常是针对具体模式的,防止不同代理人之间的技能转移。 由于今天许多代理都建立在视觉语言模型(VLM)上,我们可以通过引入Skill.png来解决这些局限性:一种获得技能般的图像输入的方法,其像素通过冷冻VLM的视觉编码器以梯度下降来优化. 图像技能与任何VLM兼容,一个单一的图像可以为一组模型共同优化. 我们显示,Skill.png在16个设置中的9个(跨越4个VLM和4个基准)使用前沿LLMs优化了最先进的文本技能,而只需要64至256个图像符号,而不是推断时大约900至2000个文本符号。 混合技能,即文本和图像技能联合优化,进一步提高代理性能. 此外,一个以VLM组合优化的图像可以成功跨过组合中的模型. Skill.png因此呈现出第一个能够以梯度降级优化的代理技能,同时保留文本技能的转移好处. 我们的代码见:https://github.com/omseeth/skill.png。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Three ways to improve agents. Text skills work with any model but cannot be optimized with gradients. LoRA is trained with gradients, but is model-specific. Skill.png (ours) encodes the skill as an image, optimized with gradients through one or more frozen models, and transfers across them.
blocks.zh: 图1:改进剂的三种方式。 文本技能与任何模型一起工作,但不能用梯度来优化. LORA受过梯度训练,但具有模型特异性. skill.png (ours) 将技能编码为图像,通过一个或多个冷冻模型以梯度优化,并跨过它们.

blocks.en: Skills, natural language instructions placed in a model’s context, have become a common way to specialize agents for new tasks, tools and domains. Beyond writing them by hand, recent work refines skills in loops where a large language model (LLM) proposes edits and keeps those that help the agent [ 1 , 3 , 20 , 32 ] . Relying on large and capable, often proprietary LLM optimizers is costly, though, compared to gradient-based optimizations, which are much more sample-efficient, as shown in adversarial research [ 24 , 29 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 技能,即放在模型背景中的自然语言指示,已成为专门从事新任务、工具和领域的一种共同方式。 除了手写外,最近的工作还精炼了大型语言模型(LLM)提议编辑和保留帮助代理[1,3,20,32]的循环技能. 依赖大型的、有能力的、往往是专有的LLM优化器成本很高,而基于梯度的优化则要高得多,正如对抗研究[24、29、6]所示。

blocks.en: One way to bypass discrete search is to optimize in continuous parameter or embedding spaces instead. Finetuning with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) [ 16 ] learns updates of a model’s weights, and visual prompt tuning [ 17 ] learns continuous prompt tokens in a model’s embedding space. Both methods are model-specific, either by merging new weights or inserting embeddings, requiring white-box access. However, parameters from a model’s latent space are not skill artifacts that can be easily handed to other agents via its input.
blocks.zh: 绕过离散搜索的一种方法是在连续参数中优化或嵌入空格. 用低档的调制(Lora)[16]学习模型重量的更新,视觉的即时调制[17]在模型的嵌入空间中学习连续的即时符号. 这两种方法都是模型特异性的,要么通过合并新的权重,要么插入嵌入,需要白箱访问. 然而,模型潜在空间的参数并不是能够轻易通过其输入而交给其他物剂的技能文物。

blocks.en: Therefore, we introduce Skill.png , which brings gradient-based optimization to skills while staying in the input space. Many agents are built on vision-language models (VLMs), and every VLM accepts images. Skill.png continuously optimizes the pixels of an image through the vision encoder of a frozen VLM and keeps them in the valid image domain (Fig. 1 ). A model provider can, for example, optimize skill images for its newest model in-house and release them alongside it. Users then simply attach these images, potentially along with text skills, to their queries without the need to access the agent’s weights again. For open-weight models, skills can also be optimized and shared by users directly.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们引入了Skill.png(Skill.png),它给技能带来了基于梯度的优化,同时停留在输入空间. 许多代理基于视觉语言模型(VLM),每个VLM接受图像. skill.png通过被冻结的VLM的视觉编码器不断优化图像的像素,并将其保存在有效的图像域(图1)中. 例如,模型提供者可以优化其内部最新模型的技能图像,并同时发布。 用户只需将这些图像与文字技能一起附加到他们的查询中,而无需再次访问代理的权重即可。 对于开放量级模型,技能也可以由用户直接优化和共享.

blocks.en: Across four VLMs and four benchmarks spanning question answering, tool use, research-level mathematics and planning, Skill.png outperforms text skills from SkillOpt, an LLM optimization loop [ 32 ] , in 9 of 16 settings significantly. It improves on the model without a skill by up to 37.8 benchmark points, while requiring only 64 to 256 image tokens instead of roughly 900 to 2000 text tokens. Text and image skills can also be combined: optimizing an image with a text skill already in context adds 6.1 to 15.5 points on three of four benchmarks. Finally, one image optimized jointly for Qwen3.5-4B and Gemma-4-E4B-it improves both models, allowing the image to transfer between the two. In summary, our contributions are: • The introduction of Skill.png , a gradient-based agent skill insertable via the input space of a frozen VLM, which requires neither weight changes nor white-box access at deployment; • an ensemble objective with per-model gradient normalization that optimizes a transferable image for VLMs of different families; • evaluation of image skills against LLM-optimized text skills on four VLMs and four benchmarks, covering multimodal skill combinations, transfer across models, and an interpretation attempt of image skills.
blocks.zh: 跨越四个VLM和四个基准,包括回答问题、工具使用、研究级数学和规划,Skill.png比SkillOpt的文本技能要好,LLM优化循环[32],在16个设置中,有9个显著。 它在没有技能的模型上改进了高达37.8个基准点,同时只需要64到256个图像符号,而不是大约900到2000个文本符号. 文本和图像技能也可以结合:用已经上下文的文本技能优化图像,在四个基准中的三个基准上增加了6.1至15.5分. 最后,一个图像为Quen3.5-4B和Gemma-4-E4B-it联合优化,使两个模型都得到了改进,使图像能够在两个模型之间转移. 简而言之,我们的贡献是:采用Skill.png,一种基于梯度的代理技能,可通过冷冻VLM的输入空间插入,在部署时不需要改变重量,也不需要白箱接入;采用按模式梯度正常化的总体目标,优化不同家庭VLM的可转让图像;在四个VLM和四个基准上对照LLM优化的文本技能评价图像技能,涵盖多式联运技能组合,跨模型的传输,以及对图像技能的解读。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Our approach combines image optimization via frozen VLMs with agent skills.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法通过冷冻VLM将图像优化与代理技能相结合.

blocks.en: Agent skills. Skills are reusable natural language instructions and resources that help agents perform specific tasks, use tools, and adapt to new domains. Beyond manually writing skills, obtaining skills more systematically is comparable to prompt optimization [ 13 , 35 , 31 ] , where large language models (LLMs) are tasked with providing better instructions. Work in skill optimization has therefore developed increasingly complex pipelines to deploy LLM optimizers for skill writing [ 1 , 3 , 20 , 31 , 34 ] . However, all of these approaches stick to text editing and inefficient sampling from LLMs.
blocks.zh: 探员技能 技能是可重复使用的自然语言指令和资源,帮助代理人执行特定任务,使用工具,并适应新的领域. 除了手动写作技能外,更系统地获得技能可与即时优化[13,35,31]相比,其中大型语言模型(LLM)的任务是提供更好的指导. 因此,技能优化工作开发了日益复杂的管道,以部署LLM优化器用于技能写作[1,3,20,31,34]. 然而,所有这些方法都坚持文字编辑和有限责任公司低效抽样。

blocks.en:
Image optimization. A new line of work has begun to explore multimodal skills. These works typically develop a combination of text and screenshots or visual highlighting that guides agents like an illustrated manual [ 18 , 30 ] . However, they rely on manual or only partially automated selections of suitable illustrations. Generating image perturbations through gradient-based updates is therefore much closer to visual prompting [ 4 , 12 ] , which has mostly been used in AI safety contexts to jailbreak VLMs [ 6 , 5 , 28 , 33 , 2 , 9 , 10 ] . In contrast to this work, we attempt to elicit a more general behavioral effect through images that goes beyond the narrow target of producing a single adversarial output from VLMs. Moreover, this behavior is intended to improve agents instead of breaking them.
Closest in spirit to our work is ART [ 8 ] , which also optimizes an image through a frozen VLM to increase task performance; we instead consider the image as an agent skill, compare it with optimized text skills, combine both, and optimize one image jointly for VLMs of different families.
blocks.zh:
图像优化. 新的工作路线已经开始探索多式联运技能。 这些作品通常将文字与截图或视觉效果结合起来,突出显示指导人员,如说明手册[18、30]。 然而,它们依靠人工或仅部分自动选择合适的插图. 因此,通过基于梯度的更新生成图像扰动更接近于视觉提示[4,12],这在AI安全背景下大多用于越狱的VLM [6,5,28,33,2,9,10]. 与这部作品形成对比的是,我们试图通过超越从VLM产生单一对抗性输出的狭隘目标的图像来引领更普遍的行为效果. 此外,这种行为是为了改善代理商而不是打破代理商.
在精神上与我们的工作最接近的是ART [8],它也通过一个冷冻的VLM来优化一个图像,以提高任务性能;我们反而将图像视为一种代理技能,将其与优化的文本技能进行比较,两者结合,并联合优化不同家庭的VLM的一个图像.

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准

blocks.en: We evaluate on four benchmarks. SearchQA [ 11 ] poses Jeopardy! questions together with web snippets retrieved for clues. The agent’s answers are scored by exact match. TRAJECT-Bench [ 15 ] is a tool use benchmark for everyday tasks. The agent must emit every required tool call from a set of tools that also contains 10 distractors. An answer counts as correct only if both the selected tools and their required parameters match exactly. LiveMathematicianBench (LiveMath) [ 14 ] asks five-way multiple-choice questions on theorems from recent arXiv papers, scored by accuracy. T1 [ 7 ] covers multi-turn travel planning: at a user turn, the agent writes Python code against flight, hotel, restaurant and attraction tools. The code is executed and scored by exact match of the resulting benchmark cache states. All benchmarks use fixed train/validation/test splits, and all reported scores are on our test split. We share further benchmark details in the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh: 我们对四项基准进行评估。 搜索QA [11] 冒出恶棍! 与网络片段一起获取的线索。 代理商的答案是通过精确的匹配来得到的. TRAJECT-Bench [15] 是日常任务的工具使用基准. 代理机必须从同时包含10个分散器的一组工具中发出所有需要的工具呼叫. 只有在所选工具及其所需的参数都完全匹配的情况下,答案才算正确。 LiveMathetician Bench (LiveMath) [14] 从近期arXiv论文中就定理提出了五向多选择问题,以准确性得分. T1[7]涵盖多回合旅行规划:在用户转弯时,代理写Python代码反对飞行,酒店,餐厅和吸引工具. 代码通过精确匹配结果的基准缓存状态执行并打分. 所有基准都使用固定列车/验证/测试分数,所有报告分数都在我们的测试分数上. 我们分享补充材料中的进一步基准细节。

blocks.en: 4.2 Vision-Language Models
blocks.zh: 4.2 远景-语言模式

blocks.en: We optimize skill images for four VLMs: Qwen3.5-4B [ 27 ] , Qwen3.5-9B [ 27 ] , Gemma-4-E4B-it [ 26 ] and Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-A3B (Nemotron-3) [ 21 ] , all kept frozen in bfloat16. Images are optimized with reasoning disabled, and unless stated otherwise, models are also evaluated in non-reasoning mode.
blocks.zh: 我们优化了四个VLM的技巧图像:Quen3.5-4B[27],Quen3.5-9B[27],Gemma-4-E4B-it[26]和Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-A3B(Nemotron-3)[21],都保存在bfloat16中. 图像被优化为推理障碍,除非另有说明,模型也以非理性模式评价.

blocks.en: A VLM’s preprocessor resizes any image that does not match its patch grid or token budget, which would place a resampling step between I skill I_{\text{skill}} and the vision encoder. We therefore set H × W H\times W per model to the smallest square size that its preprocessor passes through unchanged, so that every optimized pixel reaches the encoder as is: 256 × 256 256\times 256 for Qwen3.5, the minimum pixel count of its dynamic resizing; 512 × 512 512\times 512 for Nemotron-3, below which its preprocessor upscales to a minimum of 1024 patches; and 768 × 768 768\times 768 for Gemma-4-E4B-it, to which its preprocessor maps every square image to fill a fixed soft-token budget. This gives 64, 256 and 256 image tokens, for each VLM respectively.
blocks.zh: VLM 的预处理器会调整任何与其补丁网格或符号预算不匹配的图像大小, 这将在 I Technology IQQQQText{skill}}与视觉编码器之间设置一个复刻步骤 。 因此,我们将每个模型的H×W H\times W设定为其预处理器通过不变的最小平方大小,使每个优化的像素到达编码器,如:256×256 256\times 256 for Quen3.5,其动态重排的最小像素计数;512×512 512\times 512 for Nemotron-3,其预处理器提升到最小的1024补丁;768×768\times 768 for Gemma-4-E4B-it,其预处理器绘制每个平方图像以填补固定的软键预算. 这使得每个VLM分别得到64,256和256个图像符号.

blocks.en: I skill I_{\text{skill}} is initialized to uniform mid-gray and then optimized with Adam for 80 epochs over the training split, with a batch size of 12 and a learning rate of 0.03 that decays to zero on a cosine schedule. We lower the momentum term to β 1 = 0.5 \beta_{1}=0.5 ( β 2 = 0.999 \beta_{2}=0.999 ) so that each update follows the current gradient more closely (consider our ablation on β 1 \beta_{1} in Sec. 5.2 ). Every 100 steps, the image is scored on the validation split with the benchmark metric, and the best-scoring image is kept for testing. If no image beats the model without a skill on validation, we report the No Skill score, marked with ∗ in the tables.
blocks.zh: I技能 IQQText{skill} 初始化为统一中格力, 然后在训练分开80个时段与亚当进行优化, 批量大小为12, 学习速度为0.03, 在余弦表上衰减为0。 我们把动力学术语降低到β 1 = 0.5\βa1\ 0.5(β 2 = 0.999\βa2\ 0.999),以便每次更新都更紧密地遵循目前的梯度(考虑我们对β 1\βa\ {1}在第5.2节中的表示)。 每100步,图像在与基准度量分的验证上得分,最佳得分的图像保存在测试中. 如果没有图像比模型更优于没有验证技能的模型,我们就报告无技能分数,在表格中标有*.

blocks.en: 4.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.3 基线

blocks.en: LLM-Skill is a text skill that GPT-5.5 writes in a single pass from a description of the benchmark, its system prompt and five training examples, without feedback from any target model. One such skill per benchmark is therefore shared by all models. SkillOpt [ 32 ] creates a text skill from scratch, with GPT-6 Luna – as a cheaper alternative to GPT-5.5 – reflecting on each target model’s rollouts on the training split and keeping only edits that raise the validation score. Both skills are appended to the system prompt. Because none of the VLMs we tested allows images in the system prompt, all images must be injected with the first user request. The Supplementary Material lists all hyperparameters of our text-based optimizations as well as details of supervised finetuning via LoRA [ 16 ] as another reference.
blocks.zh: LLM-Skill是GPT-5.5从对基准的描述,它的系统即时和五个训练实例的单传中写出的一种文本技能,没有任何目标模型的反馈. 因此,每个基准都有一种技能可供所有模型使用。 SkillOpt [32] 从零开始创建文字技能, GPT-6 Luna — — 作为GPT-5.5的更便宜的替代品 — — 反思每个目标模型在训练拆分上的推出,只保留提高验证分数的编辑. 这两种技能都附在系统即时。 由于我们测试的VLM中没有任何一个允许在系统中快速的图像,所有图像都必须以第一个用户请求注入. 补充材料列出了我们文本优化的所有超参数,以及通过LORA[16]监督微调的细节。

blocks.en: 4.4 Hybrid Skill Experiments
blocks.zh: 4.4 混合技能实验

blocks.en: To test whether skills from different modalities are synergistic, we inject skills from LLM-Skill together with Skill.png images at test time. In addition to this experiment, we run SkillOpt on Nemotron-3 with Claude Sonnet 5.5 as the optimizer and then optimize I skill I_{\text{skill}} with the text skill appended to the system prompt. The SkillOpt skill is thus part of T text T_{\text{text}} during the training, validation and test query.

blocks.en: 5.1 Transferability of Skills
blocks.zh: 5.1 技能可转让性

blocks.en: We test transfer with Qwen3.5-4B as the source model and inject each of its skills unchanged into Gemma-4-E4B-it, Qwen3.5-9B and Nemotron-3. We compare four skills: the SkillOpt text skill that GPT-6 Luna optimized on Qwen3.5-4B; an UltraBreak image [ 9 ] optimized on Qwen3.5-4B; the Skill.png image optimized on Qwen3.5-4B alone; and an ensemble image optimized jointly on Qwen3.5-4B and Gemma-4-E4B-it with the objective of Section 3.1 . UltraBreak was built for jailbreak images that transfer across models. We use it as another image optimization as well as a transfer baseline. Its loss is not cross-entropy on the target tokens. Instead, it pulls a token’s embedding expected under the model’s next-token distribution toward the embeddings of the target tokens. During training, the image is randomly rotated, scaled and shifted, with an additional total-variation penalty. We set its targets to the gold answers, give it the same step budget as Skill.png , and keep its final image, as UltraBreak does. We share all hyperparameters used for UltraBreak in the Supplementary Material. At test time, each transferred image is passed at its optimized size and the target model’s own preprocessor resizes it where the target model expects a larger input.
blocks.zh: 我们以Quen3.5-4B作为源模型进行测试转录,并将每种技能都注入Gemma-4-E4B-it,Quen3.5-9B和Nemotron-3. 我们比较了四种技能:GPT-6 Luna在Quen3.5-4B上优化的SkillOpt文本技能;在Quen3.5-4B上优化的UltraBreak图像[9];单在Quen3.5-4B上优化的Skill.png图像;在Quen3.5-4B和Gemma-4-E4B-it上联合优化的综艺图像,目标为3.1节. UltraBreak是为跨模型传输的越狱图像而建造的. 我们把它作为另一个图像优化和传输基线。 其损失在目标标志上并不交叉. 相反,它拉动了寄信符的嵌入,期望在模型的下个插孔分布中向目标代币嵌入。 在训练期间,图像被随机旋转,缩放和转动,并附加一个总变换的罚单. 我们为黄金答案设定了目标, 给它同样的步骤预算 Skill.png, 并保持其最终形象, 如UltraBreak所做的。 我们分享补充材料中用于UltraBreak的所有超参数。 在测试时,每个被转移的图像以优化大小通过,目标模型自己的预处理器在目标模型期望更大输入的地方调整其大小.

blocks.en: The image optimized on Qwen3.5-4B alone changes performance of Gemma-4-E4B-it by only − 1.96 -1.96 to + 1.67 +1.67 points, whereas the ensemble image raises it by 11.71 to 35.07 points on SearchQA, LiveMath and T1 ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 ). On Qwen3.5-4B, the ensemble image even surpasses the model’s own Skill.png on all four benchmarks, significantly on TRAJECT ( + 9.98 +9.98 ), LiveMath ( + 7.95 +7.95 ) and T1 ( + 5.50 +5.50 ) (Fig. 3 ). On TRAJECT, the ensemble image also lifts Qwen3.5-4B by 9.82 points, while no model’s own image improves over No Skill (Tab. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 仅Qwen3.5-4B上优化的图像仅将Gemma-4-E4B-it的性能改变−1.96-1.96到+1.67+1.67分,而综艺图像则在SearchQA,LiveMath和T1上提升了11.71到35.07分(p < 0.01 p < 0.01). 在Quen3.5-4B上,综艺的画面甚至超过了模型自己的技能. 所有四个基准的png,其中显著的有TRAJECT(+9.98+9.98),LiveMath(+7.95+7.95)和T1(+5.50+5.50)(图3). 在TRAJECT上,综艺图像也将Quen3.5-4B提升9.82分,而没有任何模型自己的图像比无技能改进(Tab. 1).

blocks.en: However, transfer beyond the ensemble remains weak for all kinds of skills. The SkillOpt skill from GPT-6 Luna of Qwen3.5-4B raises all three target models on SearchQA by 1.93 to 5.93 points ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ), but no other benchmark significantly. The Skill.png from Qwen3.5-4B changes the held-out Qwen3.5-9B and Nemotron-3 by − 2.09 -2.09 to + 2.78 +2.78 points, and none of the ensemble images improve transfer to unseen models. UltraBreak does not work off the shelf for skills: its image does not even improve Qwen3.5-4B, on which it is optimized, and lowers LiveMath by 9.21 points ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ). Consequently, it does not transfer either, changing the other three models by − 2.51 -2.51 to + 1.21 +1.21 points. The few significant gains, all on Nemotron-3, are on par with those of a random image (compare with Tab. 1 ). We, therefore, report that joint optimization extends an image to the models it is optimized on, but not to unseen ones.
blocks.zh: 然而,对于各种技能而言,超越综艺的转会仍然很薄弱。 技能 来自Qwen3.5-4B的GPT-6 Luna的Opt技能将搜索QA上的所有三个目标模型都提升了1.93到5.93分(p < 0.05 p < 0.05),但没有其他显著的基准. Quen3.5-4B的Skill.png号机 将被搁置的Quen3.5-9B和Nemotron-3以−2.09-2.09更改为+2.78+2.78分,综艺图像中没有任何一个能改进向隐形模型的传输. UltraBreak在技能的架子上没有工作:它的形象甚至没有改进Quen3.5-4B,它在上面被优化,并且将LiveMath降低9.21分(p < 0.05 p < 0.05). 因此,它也没有转移,将其他三种型号改为−2.51-2.51,改为+1.21+1.21点。 因此,我们报告说,联合优化将图像扩展到它所优化的模型,而不是隐形模型。

blocks.en: Beyond other models, we also test transfer to reasoning mode: each skill, optimized with reasoning disabled, is injected unchanged into the same model with reasoning enabled. We test SearchQA, TRAJECT and T1. Skill.png still improves on No Skill in reasoning mode in 7 of these 12 settings, but beats the SkillOpt skill less consistently (see the Supplementary Material for detailed results).
blocks.zh: 除了其他模型外,我们还测试了向推理模式的转移:每种技能,在推理被禁用的情况下得到优化,在推理被允许的情况下被注入到同一个模型中. 我们测试搜索QA,TRAJECT和T1. Skill.png在这12个设置中的7个设置中仍然改进了无技能推理模式,但比SkillOpt技能更不连贯(详细结果见补充材料).

blocks.en: 5.2 Ablations
blocks.zh: 5.2 违约

blocks.en: We vary the size of the skill image for Qwen3.5-4B on SearchQA and T1, from 64 × 64 64\times 64 to 768 × 768 768\times 768 , and keep the rest of the recipe fixed. Sizes below 256 × 256 256\times 256 are bicubically upscaled to it by Qwen3.5-4B’s preprocessor before they reach the encoder, so they keep the token count and only reduce the number of free pixels. Up to 320 × 320 320\times 320 , we further optimize each image with three training seeds and report the mean and sample standard deviation across seeds. Because they are the most expensive to optimize, the 512 × 512 512\times 512 and 768 × 768 768\times 768 images use a single seed. To test whether the gains come from the optimized content rather than from the presence of an image, we also replace Skill.png with a uniform-noise image of the same size for each model.

blocks.en: 5.3 Interpreting Skill.png
blocks.zh: 5.3 解释技能.png

blocks.en: A human can read a text skill and check what it tells the agent. A Skill.png image offers no such access: it resembles colorful noise (see examples in Fig. 6 ). Its performance gains alone do not reveal whether the VLM extracts content from the image, as it would from a text skill, or whether the pixels merely steer the model without any meaning attached. We therefore test whether Skill.png images carry meaning that the VLMs themselves can put into words. We show every Skill.png image to all four models, together with the random image of our noise control. The image is shared in a user turn with no system prompt and no task, together with one of five open questions: (1) describe the image, (2) transcribe its text, (3) say what instruction it gives, (4) rewrite it as a system prompt, and (5) list ten words it brings to mind. We sample five answers per question [ 23 ] . An LLM judge, GLM-5.3-Flash, which sees only the question and the answer, labels each answer, for example whether it calls the image noise or corrupted and which task it connects the image with. We validate its labels with Claude Opus 5.5 as a second judge [ 25 ] ; the two judges agree with Cohen’s κ = 0.91 \kappa=0.91 (details are shared in the Supplementary Material).
blocks.zh: 人类可以读取文字技能,检查它告诉代理人什么. A Skill.png 图像不提供这种访问:它类似于多彩的噪音(见图6的例子)。 它的性能增益本身并不能揭示VLM是否像文字技能那样从图像中提取内容,或者像素是否只是引导模型而没有任何附加意义. 因此,我们检验Skill.png图像是否意味着VLMs本身可以将图像放入文字中. 我们把每个Skill.png的图像 展示给所有四个模型, 以及我们的噪声控制的随机图像。 图像在用户转弯时共享,没有系统即时和任务,加上5个开口问题之一:(1)描述图像,(2)转录其文本,(3)说其给出的指示,(4)重写为系统即时,(5)列出它引人注意的10个字. 我们抽查了每个问题五个答案 [23]. LLM评委GLM-5.3-Flash只看到问答,给每个答案贴上标签,例如它是否叫图像噪声或损坏,以及它与图像连接的任务是什么. 我们以克劳德·奥普斯·5.5作为第二位法官验证其标签;两位法官同意科恩的0.91\kappa=0.91(详情在补充材料中共享)。

blocks.en: The VLMs from our investigation consider their own Skill.png pixels to be much more than noise, while the other models do not see anything in them (Tab. 3 ). A model calls its own Skill.png noisy or corrupted in less than a quarter of its answers (even 0% for Nemotron-3 and only 1% for Qwen3.5-9B). In contrast, VLMs consider the images of other models to be noise 47% to 85% of the time, close to the 56% to 96% when prompted with our random image controls. The pattern also holds when each image is shown under the system prompt of its benchmark (consider the Supplementary Material). The ensemble images of Sec. 5.1 follow the same pattern: Qwen3.5-4B and Gemma-4-E4B-it, on which they were optimized, call them noise or corrupted in only 1% and 3% of their answers, Qwen3.5-9B and Nemotron-3 in 77% and 32%. What a Skill.png conveys therefore appears to be specific to the VLMs it was optimized on.
blocks.zh: 我们调查的VLM认为他们有自己的技能 png像素比噪声大得多,而其他模型在它们中看不到任何东西(Tab. 3). 一个模型称自己的Skill.png吵闹或者在不到四分之一的答案中腐烂(Nemotron-3甚至只有0%,Quen3.5-9B只有1%). 相比之下,VLMs认为其他模型的图像是47%到85%的时间噪声,在我们的随机图像控制刺激下接近56%到96%的时间. 当每个图像在系统提示下显示其基准(考虑补充材料)时,模式也保持不变。 Sec. 5.1的综艺图像遵循相同的模式: Quen3.5-4B和Gemma-4-E4B-it,他们在上面被优化,称其噪音或只在1%和3%的答案中腐烂,Quen3.5-9B和Nemotron-3在77%和32%中被破坏. 因此,Skill.png的表示似乎与它最优化的VLM有关。

blocks.en: In only a few cases, the meanings that VLMs derive from Skill.png images appear to align with the task domains for which the images were optimized. Gemma-4-E4B-it and Nemotron-3 appear to connect their Skill.png images to domain-related content. According to our LLM judge, the images evoke domain-related responses in 19% and 17% of their answers, the two Qwen3.5 models in at most 1%, and no model ever does so for the image of another model or the random image. We observe the clearest case of domain semantics for the SearchQA image of Gemma-4-E4B-it (see Fig. 6 , left). While the other three models consider it meaningless, Gemma-4-E4B-it generates, in all responses to our probes, texts that mention concepts connected to SearchQA, such as a “fill-in-the-blank quiz”. The VLM seems to recognize via the image a distinct domain with tasks. Moreover, when shown the T1 Skill.png image, Gemma-4-E4B-it occasionally produces travel-related words and even tool-like names such as next_location closely related to T1 (Fig. 6 , right). This does not hold for every Skill.png image consistently though: Gemma-4-E4B-it calls its own LiveMath image noise or corrupted in 23 of 25 answers. According to our LLM judge, Nemotron-3 ties its LiveMath image to mathematics in 15 of 25 answers, but it also names mathematics in 11 answers on its three other images.
blocks.zh: 仅在少数情况下,VLMs从Skill.png图像中衍生出来的意义似乎与图像被优化的任务域一致. Gemma-4-E4B-it和Nemotron-3似乎将其skill.png图像与域相关内容连接. 根据LLM的判断,这些图像在19%和17%的答案中 引起了与域有关的答复, 最多是1%的两个Quen3.5模型, 没有任何模型对另一个模型或随机图像的图像如此。 我们观测到Gemma-4-E4B-it的搜索QA图像最清晰的域语义案例(见图6,左)。 虽然其他三种模型认为没有意义,但Gemma-4-E4B-it在对我们的探测器的所有答复中,都产生了提及与SearchQA有关的概念的文本,例如“填充空白的测试”。 VLM似乎通过图像认识到一个有任务的独特域. 此外,在显示T1 Skill.png图像时,Gemma-4-E4B-it偶尔会生成与旅行有关的单词,甚至类似工具的名称,如与T1密切相关的下一个位置(图6,右). 这对每个技能来说并不重要。 Gemma-4-E4B-it自称自己的LiveMath图像噪音, 根据我们的LLM判断,Nemotron-3将它的LiveMath图像与数学联系起来,在25个答案中的15个答案中,它也将数学命名为另外三个图像中的11个答案.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We have shown that an agent skill can be learned with gradient descent and passed to a model as an ordinary input. In 9 of 16 model–benchmark pairs, a single optimized image helped the agent more than a text skill refined by an LLM optimizer, at a fraction of the context length. We could achieve even higher performance gains with multimodal combinations of skills, providing the agents with both text and image skills. However, what skill images encode is neither legible to the human eye nor apparently to other VLMs, which mostly describe Skill.png images from other models as noise. Only the model for which a skill image was optimized appears to treat it as input with semantic content.
blocks.zh: 我们已经表明,一种代理技能可以用梯度下降来学习,并传递给模型作为普通输入. 在16个模型–基准对齐中的9个中,一个单一优化的图像比一个LLM优化器精炼的文本技能更能帮助代理,在上下文长度的一小部分. 我们可以通过多种形式的技能组合实现更高的业绩收益,为代理人提供文字和图像技能。 然而,什么技能图像编码在人类眼中既无法辨别,也显然无法辨别其他VLM,而VLM大多描述的是Skill. 其他模型的 png 图像作为噪音 。 只有对技能图像进行优化的模型似乎将其视为带有语义内容的输入.

blocks.en: Our results should be read with some caution. Image skills did not help on every task: on TRAJECT, where tool calls and their parameters must match exactly, they brought no significant gain. One hypothesis for this outcome could be that TRAJECT places all tool definitions several thousand tokens in length in the system prompt, which removes the image skill injected with the user query from the main input areas a VLM would pay most of its attention to [ 19 ] . Where image skills did help, some of the gains may not necessarily reflect broadly improved abilities. We believe that neither a skill image nor a LoRA adapter trained on 73 LiveMath questions would turn a small VLM into a research mathematician; both methods most likely pick up on properties of the benchmark, such as its answer format or patterns in its answer options. But we consider this a legitimate outcome: skills exist to specialize an agent for a task or domain, and Skill.png does so successfully like text skills.
blocks.zh: 应当谨慎地阅读我们的结果。 图像技能对每一项任务都没有帮助:在TRAJECT上,工具调用及其参数必须准确匹配,它们没有带来重大收益. 这一结果的一个假设是,TRAJECT将所有工具定义的长度都放在系统提示器中,从而将输入用户查询的图像技能从主要输入区中去除,VLM将主要关注[19]. 在图像技能确实有帮助的地方,一些成果不一定反映能力普遍提高。 我们认为,无论是技能图像还是LORA适配器,在73个LiveMath问题上都无法将一个小的VLM变成一个研究数学家;两种方法都极有可能从基准的属性中汲取,比如其答案格式或答案选项中的规律. 但是,我们认为这是一个合法的结果:存在专门从事某项任务或领域的代理人的技能,以及技能。 png如此成功地喜欢文本技能.

blocks.en: The combination and transfer experiments point in the same direction: an image works best in the setting it was optimized in. Adding the LLM-Skill to the system prompt of an image optimized without it improved on the text skill alone in 9 of 16 model–benchmark pairs, but on T1 still scored 16.21 to 26.14 points below the image skills. Once we optimize the image together with the text skill, the two complement each other and give Nemotron-3 its best scores on LiveMath and T1. Synergy between text and image skills seems to require joint optimization strategies. This opens up many new possibilities because every text skill could be potentially complemented with Skill.png images. Our transferability experiments further emphasize that skill images are dependent on their optimization setup. An image optimized for Qwen3.5-4B and Gemma-4-E4B-it at once improved both, on Qwen3.5-4B even beyond its own image, yet no image increased scores of our held-out VLMs. This confirms recent findings on image transferability between VLMs [ 22 ] : images appear to require ensemble optimization, and they transfer only among the ensemble of models.
blocks.zh: 组合和转移实验指向同一方向:一个图像在它被优化的设定中最有效. 将LLM-Skill添加到一个优化图像的系统提示上,但没有在16个模型–基准对中的9个中单提高文本技能,但是在T1上仍然在图像技能以下得16.21至26.14分. 一旦我们把图像与文字技巧一起优化,两人就互相补充,并在LiveMath和T1上给予尼莫特龙-3最好的分数. 文本和图像技能之间的协同似乎需要联合优化战略。 这带来了许多新的可能性,因为每一种文本技能都有可能与Skill.png图像互补。 我们的可转移性实验进一步强调技能图像取决于其优化设置. 对Quen3.5-4B和Gemma-4-E4B-it的图像进行了优化,同时在Quen3.5-4B上进行了改进,甚至超越了自己的图像,然而没有图像增加了我们被搁置的VLM的分数. 这证实了最近关于VLMs [22] 之间的图像可转移性的调查结果:图像似乎需要综艺优化,它们只在模型的综艺中进行传输.

blocks.en: Skill.png invites multiple follow-up experiments. Text and image skills could be optimized in parallel instead of one after the other, and larger, more diverse VLM ensembles may reach models outside of them. Our images were also optimized with reasoning disabled and helped less reliably once it was enabled, which optimizing with explicit reasoning data may fix.
blocks.zh: Skill.png邀请多个后续实验. 文本和图像技能可以平行地优化,而不是一个接一个地优化,更大,更多样化的VLM组合可能到达其外的模型. 我们的图像也因推理功能被禁用而得到优化,一旦被启用,帮助的可靠性就会下降,而通过明确推理数据实现优化则可能得到补救。

blocks.en: A Benchmark Details
blocks.zh: 基准细节

blocks.en: SearchQA uses 400/200/1400 questions with clues: the training instances come from the official training split, and disjoint validation and test instances come from the official validation split. For TRAJECT, we drop 925 of 1800 queries whose gold calls require a value that the query never states. The remaining 875 are split into 175/89/611, with queries sharing a domain and set of gold tool providers kept in the same split. LiveMath is split randomly at 2:1:7 with one question per paper. We remove questions whose gold option can be identified from its wording alone 2 2 2 This shortcut has been raised as an issue of LiveMath here https://github.com/LinyangHe/LiveMathematicianBench/issues/1 . , leaving 73/33/239 instances. Since LiveMath always lists the correct option first, we shuffle the options of each question with a fixed seed. For T1, we draw 400/200/1400 user turns from T1’s own train, validation, and test splits, balanced across the benchmark’s domains.

blocks.en: B LLM-Skill, SkillOpt, UltraBreak Hyperparameters
blocks.zh: B LLM- Skill, SkillOpt, UltraBreak 超参数

blocks.en: GPT-5.5 at medium reasoning effort receives a description of the benchmark, its system prompt verbatim, the scoring rules, and five training examples with their gold answers, drawn with a fixed seed. It is asked for procedural, generalizable guidance of at most about 1,500 words, with no instance-specific content and no change to the answer format. The generator never sees a score or a model output, and the skill is not revised. The skill is then appended to the system prompt as a separate section.
blocks.zh: GPT-5.5在中度推理努力中得到了基准的描述,其系统迅速逐字记录,评分规则,以及5个带有黄金答案的训练例子,用固定种子绘制. 要求它最多提供大约1,500个字的程序性和一般性指导,没有具体实例的内容,答复格式也没有变化。 生成器从未看到分数或模型输出,技能也没有修改. 技能随后作为单独的一节附在系统上。

blocks.en: We run the official implementation with its default recipe, plugging in our prompts, splits, scoring and inference for the target model. The optimizers are GPT-6 Luna and, additionally for Nemotron-3, Claude Sonnet 5.5 at extra-high reasoning effort. Starting from an empty skill, SkillOpt runs 4 epochs with 40 training items per step. The optimizer reflects on the target’s rollouts in minibatches of 8 and applies at most 4 edits per step, a budget that decays to 2 on a cosine schedule. A candidate skill is accepted only if it raises the validation score, and the best one is kept. Rollouts use the test-time decoding with reasoning disabled.
blocks.zh: 我们用它默认的食谱来运行官方执行,插入我们的提示,分数,评分和推断目标模型. 优化者是GPT-6 Luna,另外还有Nemotron-3,Claude Sonnet 5.5在超高推理努力. 从空技能开始,Skillopt运行4个世纪,每步40个训练项目. 优化器反映目标在8号小炮的推出,每步最多4个编辑时适用,这一预算在余弦表上衰减到2个。 考生技能只有在提高考核分数时才被接受,最佳技能才被保留. Rollouts使用测试时间解码,推理功能被禁用.

blocks.en: We reimplement UltraBreak on top of our training loop and keep the hyperparameters of its official implementation [ 9 ] . As the surrogate we use Qwen3.5-4B. One image per benchmark is optimized on it and then injected unchanged into every model. Optimization starts from uniform noise and uses Adam with a constant learning rate of 0.01 and β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , plus a total-variation (TV) penalty with weight 0.5. For every training item, the image is drawn as a patch at two thirds of the canvas side. It is then rotated by an angle from [ − 15 ∘ , 15 ∘ ] [-15^{\circ},15^{\circ}] , scaled by a factor from [ 0.8 , 1.2 ] [0.8,1.2] , and pasted at a random position on a white canvas. The loss is UltraBreak’s attention-based semantic loss. It compares, by cosine similarity, the embedding expected under the next-token distribution with an attention-weighted mix of the current and all later target embeddings. Its settings are temperature τ = 0.5 \tau=0.5 , a positional-encoding weight of 0.01 and Gaussian noise with standard deviation 10 − 4 10^{-4} . As in the original, we keep the image of the final step, and validation only monitors the run. Everything else matches Skill.png : the 256 × 256 256\times 256 image, the training split, gold answers as targets, 80 epochs with batches of 12 items, reasoning disabled, and the injection site and decoding at test time.
blocks.zh: 我们重新执行UltraBreak 在我们的训练循环之上,并保持它的超参数 官方执行 [9]. 作为代孕者,我们使用Quen3.5-4B. 每个基准都优化一个图像,然后不加修改地注入每个模型。 优化从统一噪声开始,使用亚当的常年学习率为0.01,β 1 = 0.9\β1+ 0.9,加上总变异(TV)的罚有重量0.5. 对于每个训练项目,图像作为补丁绘制在画布一侧的三分之二. 然后从[− 15 , 15∘] [-15^{\crc}, 15^{\crc}]的角度旋转, 从[0.8, 1.2] [0.8,1.2] 的角度缩放一个系数, 贴在白色画布上随机位置. 这一损失是UltraBreak基于注意力的语义损失. 它通过余弦的相似性,比较了下个托盘分布下预期的嵌入,同时将当前和所有后期目标嵌入的注意力加权搭配. 它的设置为温度τ = 0.5\tau= 0.5,位置编码重量为0.01,高斯噪音为标准偏差 10− 4 10^{-4}. 和原作一样,我们保留最后一步的画面,验证只监视运行. 其他一切都符合Skill.png : 256×256\times 256图像,训练分裂,黄金答案作为目标,80个时代分批12项,推理被禁,以及试时的注射网站和解码.

blocks.en: Our implementation deviates from the original in four respects. First, the targets are the benchmarks’ gold answers rather than an affirmative jailbreak prefix. The prompt also carries no instruction to start the response with that prefix. Second, the canvas has the size of the image ( 256 256 px), instead of a 224 224 px patch on a 336 336 px canvas. At test time the bare image fills the whole input, so the model sees it about 1.5 times larger than on average during training. The original instead shows the patch at its training scale. UltraBreak’s purpose, though, is to robustify the images against scaling effects and we want to keep the resolution similar to the one from Skill.png for comparison. Third, the original inserts the patch’s raw [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] values into the already normalized pixel tensor. We compose the canvas in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and normalize it with each model’s own preprocessing, as at test time. Fourth, the step budget is that of Skill.png (560 to 2,720 steps, depending on the benchmark), not 5,000 steps over the full training set. Smaller differences: the patch edges blend bilinearly into the background instead of masking out black pixels, and the positional encoding is computed in single rather than bfloat16 precision.
blocks.zh: 我们的执行在四个方面偏离了原来的。 而不是正面的越狱前缀。 提示中也没有以该前缀启动响应的指示 。 第二,画布具有图像大小(256 256 px),而不是336 336 px画布上的224 224 px补丁. 在测试时赤裸的图像会填充整个输入,所以模型看到它比训练时的平均值大约1.5倍. 原版则以训练尺度显示补丁. 但UltraBreak的目的是用缩放效果来强化图像, png比较. 第三,原始将补丁的原始 [0, 1] [0, 1] 值插入到已经正常的像素计数器中. 我们用 [0, 1] [0, 1] 来编画画布, 并在测试时使画布与每个模型本身的预处理正常化 。 第四,步骤预算是Skill.png(560至2 720步,视基准而定),而不是超过全套培训的5 000步。 较小的区别:补丁边缘将双线性地混合到背景中,而不是遮盖出黑色像素,位置编码是用单个而不是bfloat16精度计算出来的.

blocks.en: C LoRA Finetuning
blocks.zh: CLORA 微调

blocks.en: To finetune all VLMs, we use LoRA [ 16 ] , which adapts the attention and MLP weights of the target model’s language model. Adapters of rank 16 ( α = 32 \alpha=32 , dropout 0.05) are placed on the attention and MLP projections of the language model; the vision encoder and routed MoE experts are not adapted. We train with AdamW at a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} without weight decay, a batch size of 8 for 10 epochs, 5% linear warmup followed by cosine decay, and gradient clipping at 1.0. The loss is the supervised cross-entropy of Skill.png on the gold answer. The adapter is scored on the validation split after every epoch, and the best one, including the unadapted model, is kept. We report LoRA as another method that uses gradient-based updates, but does not produce input space skills.
blocks.zh: 为了微调所有VLM,我们使用LORA [16],它适应目标模型语言模型的注意力和MLP重量. 16级(α = 32\alpha = 32, district 0.05)的适配器被放在语言模型的注意力和MLP预测上;视觉编码器和路由的MOE专家没有适应. 我们和AdamW一起训练的学习速度为 2× 10− 4 2\times 10× 4}没有重量衰减, 批量尺寸为 8 对10个纪元, 5%的线性暖化, 其次是 余弦衰减, 梯度剪切 1.0。 损失是受监督的Skill的交叉进化. Png在黄金答案。 适配器在每个纪元之后的验证分数上得分,包括未适应模型在内的最佳型号保留下来. 我们报告LORA是另一种使用梯度更新的方法,但不产生输入空间技能.

blocks.en: D Interpretation Details of Skill.png
blocks.zh: D. 技能解释细节.png

blocks.en: Each VLM is queried with reasoning disabled. For every question, five answers are sampled at temperature 0.7 with a fixed seed per sample. Each Skill.png is provided as part of the query at the size it was optimized at, and the random image at the same resolution. Image and each respective question form a single user turn without a system prompt. The five open questions are: (1) “Describe this image in detail.”; (2) “Transcribe any text, letters, numbers or symbols you can read in this image, exactly as they appear. If there are none, say so.”; (3) “This image was given to you as an instruction. What is it telling you to do?”; (4) “Rewrite what this image conveys as a short system prompt, at most five sentences, for an AI assistant.”; and (5) “List ten words or concepts this image makes you think of, separated by commas.” Each model thus gives 25 answers per image, 100 per model from the respective Skill.png images of SearchQA, TRAJECT-Bench, LiveMath, and T1.
blocks.zh: 每个 VLM 被询问的推理被禁用 。 对于每一个问题,在0.7温度下对五个答案进行取样,每个样本有一个固定的种子. 每个skill.png作为查询的一部分,以它最优化的大小提供,以及同一分辨率的随机图像. 图像和每个相应的问题组成一个单一的用户回合,而无需系统提示. 五个未决问题是:(1) “详细描述这一形象”。 (2) “将您在本图像中能够读取的任何文字、字母、数字或符号,按其显示的准确程度排列。 如果没有,请说。” (3) “这种形象是作为指示给予你的。 它让你做什么?” (4) “为AI助手改写这个图像所传达的短系统,最多为5句”;和(5)“列出这个图像让你想到的十个字或概念,用逗号分隔。” 因此,每个模型每个图像给出25个答案,每个模型从各自的技能中给出100个答案. 搜索QA,TRAJECT-Bench,LiveMath和T1的png图像.

blocks.en: GLM-5.3-Flash, queried over OpenRouter at temperature 0 and low reasoning effort, labels each VLM’s answer in a fixed JSON schema. A VLM’s answer also counts as calling the image “noise” or “corrupted” if the judge finds that the model describes the image, or most of it, to be static, grain or random pixels, glitched, distorted or broken. The judge picks the subject the answer connects the image with from a fixed list of options, consisting of a) travel planning, b) code that calls travel tools, c) trivia, d) question answering from passages, e) mathematics, f) choosing or calling API tools, g) another subject, and h) none. An answer is considered a domain match if the option maps to the benchmarks from which the Skill.png image was optimized.
blocks.zh: GLM-5.3-Flash对OpenRouter在0温度和低推理努力时的询问,将每个VLM的答案标注在固定的JSON计划中. VLM的答案也算作称图像为"噪声"或"腐烂",如果法官发现模型描述的图像,或大部分是静态的,粒状或随机的像素,闪烁,扭曲或断裂. 法官从固定的选项列表中选择将图像连接起来的主题,其中包括:(a) 旅行规划,(b) 调用旅行工具的代码,(c) trivia,(d) 从段落中回答的问题,(e) 数学,(f) 选择或调用API工具,(g) 另一个主题,(h) 无。 如果选项映射到优化Skill.png图像的基准,则答案被视为域匹配。

blocks.en: A second annotator model, Claude Opus 5.5, labeled 100 randomly drawn open answers, 25 per model, without seeing the judge’s labels. On whether an answer calls the image noise or corrupted, GLM-5.3-Flash and Opus 5.5 agree in 96 of 100 answers (Cohen’s κ = 0.91 \kappa=0.91 ).
blocks.zh: 第二个注释员模型克劳德·奥普斯·5.5(英语:Claude Opus 5.5),标注了100个随机抽取的开放式答案,每个模型25个,没有看到法官的标签. GLM-5.3-Flash和Opus 5.5在100个回答中的96个(Cohen's $ = 0.91\kappa= 0.91)中同意,

blocks.en: Finally, we repeat the evaluation with each Skill.png shown under the system prompt of its benchmark, and the uniform-noise image under each of the four. Each model still calls its own images noise or corrupted in up to 23% of its answers, and the images of the other models in 30% to 75% (Tab. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 最后,我们重复评估,每个Skill.png在系统下显示其基准的速率,四个系统下显示的统一噪音图像。 每个模型仍然称自己的图像噪声或者在高达23%的答案中腐烂,其他模型的图像则以30%到75%(Tab. 4)表示.
